class.name: SPZLoader
class.brief_description: Loader for Niantic's SPZ compressed Gaussian Splatting format.
class.description: Reads SPZ using the pinned official Niantic decoder. Versions 1-3 use gzip, and version 4 uses independent Zstd streams. Historical GodotGS header-plus-gzip wrappers remain readable. Preserves SH degrees 0-4 and antialiased training metadata. Position, quaternion and SH coordinate conversions are applied together into Godot coordinates. Log scales and logit opacity are activated once. Runtime color stores the SH-DC contribution; the renderer adds its 0.5 bias. Input, expanded streams and staging allocations are bounded before decoding. Unsupported extensions are rejected. A failed reload preserves the previous valid resource and statistics. Imported assets are reimported for the corrected data contract; rendering SH4 and antialias compensation also requires renderer support.

method.name: load_file
method.description: Loads an SPZ file from the given filesystem path. Returns [constant OK] on success. After loading, retrieve the result with [method get_gaussian_data].

method.name: get_gaussian_data
method.description: Returns the [GaussianData] resource produced by the most recent successful [method load_file] call. Before the first successful load, returns an empty resource.

method.name: get_splat_count
method.description: Returns the number of Gaussian splats parsed from the loaded SPZ file.

method.name: get_load_statistics
method.description: Returns a dictionary of load statistics including format version, SH degree, splat count, and world-space bounds.
